purpose: Teach: 粉末/芳香/ソーラー/バカンス/渓谷/チャーハン/半袖/しょうゆ

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お母さんがお茶の粉末を買ってこられたわ
lines.en: Sho, your mom picked up some tea powder for us.
lines.style: Warm, matter-of-fact observation. Gentle pace. The tone of someone sharing a small domestic detail with affection. No urgency, just noticing.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お祖母ちゃんのお花の芳香が大好き
lines.en: Mei-sis, I really love Grandma's flower scent.
lines.style: Small voice, genuine delight. Quick pace on the love part — unselfconscious. The kind of six-year-old who says what he actually feels without filtering it.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがソーラー電卓を見せて下さったわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad showed me his solar calculator earlier.
lines.style: Soft, almost to herself. Thoughtful pace. The tone of someone reflecting on a small moment that caught her attention. Slight smile in the voice.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、夏休みのバカンスが楽しみだよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I'm really looking forward to summer vacation.
lines.style: Bright anticipation. The words come a little faster — genuine excitement about something coming. Unguarded, the way he is with someone he trusts.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんと渓谷の温泉に行きたいわね
lines.en: Sho, I'd like to go to that mountain hot spring with your dad sometime.
lines.style: Gentle, dreamy quality. Slower pace. She's thinking aloud, sharing a wish. The tone says she's been turning this over in her mind. Tender but not performed.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、ママのチャーハン大好きだよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I love the fried rice Mom makes.
lines.style: Small, satisfied voice. The comfort of stating something he knows for certain. Natural pace, matter-of-fact affection. He's speaking a truth he's thought about.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、夏服の半袖を出しておきましょうね
lines.en: Sho, let's get your summer short-sleeves out of the closet, okay?
lines.style: Practical, gentle task-setting. Warm and organizational. The tone of someone caring for him through doing — not commanding, inviting him into the small work.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お祖母ちゃんのしょうゆ漬けが好き
lines.en: Mei-sis, I like Grandma's soy-pickled vegetables.
lines.style: Small, contented voice. Matter-of-fact. The way he catalogs the things he loves without self-consciousness. A quiet moment of him just being himself.
